tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Sidebar and window frame. The deepest surface; the logo's warm near-black.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Content area behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Cards (engine, project, asset), task rows, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill on cards and rows; selected nav item; secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only: cards are also set apart by fill.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 on bg-100 and bg-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every bg-* surface (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, engine paths, captions, inactive nav labels. 6:1 or more on every bg-*.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, empty-state hints. 4.6:1 or more on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200; do not use on bg-300.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Fill of primary buttons, the active nav marker, progress bars, focus of the current step. Never for status.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Border of accent fills. In light the amber fill alone is 1.9:1 on the page, so primary buttons carry this 1px edge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9:1 dark, 8.5:1 light). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber used as text: links, the selected tab label, the version numeral on a selected engine card. 4.8:1 or more on every bg-* in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the selected nav item and the update banner.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the surface color. 10:1 dark, 4.8:1 light on bg-100.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done tasks, GitHub access ok, installed. Text 4.7:1 or more on bg-100 and bg-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Missing engine for a project, low disk space, paused task. Pair with triangle-alert; it sits next to amber, so the icon carries the meaning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed tasks, crash reports, destructive actions (uninstall, delete).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a success badge.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warning badge or the missing-engine strip on a project card.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a danger badge and the crash banner.

tokens.name: thumb-1
tokens.usage: Placeholder thumbnail fill, picked by hashing the project or asset name (1 of 5). Initials in ink.

tokens.name: thumb-2
tokens.usage: Placeholder thumbnail fill (2 of 5).

tokens.name: thumb-3
tokens.usage: Placeholder thumbnail fill (3 of 5).

tokens.name: thumb-4
tokens.usage: Placeholder thumbnail fill (4 of 5).

tokens.name: thumb-5
tokens.usage: Placeholder thumbnail fill (5 of 5).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, and the gradient-free strip under text laid over a thumbnail.

styles.name: version-numeral
styles.usage: The engine version on an engine card (5.7). Tabular figures, tracking -0.02em. The one big moment on the Library screen.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Library, Fab, Tasks, Settings. One per screen.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section headers inside a screen (ENGINE VERSIONS, MY PROJECTS). Uppercase, tracking 0.08em, ink-muted.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Project and asset names on cards, dialog titles, task titles. One line, ellipsis.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, descriptions, dialog copy, help text.
styles.sample: Compiles Unreal Engine from source. Takes several hours.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, nav labels, emphasized words in body.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a card title: engine version, asset kind, sizes, dates.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, git refs, log lines and error excerpts.

styles.name: mono-figures
styles.usage: Live numbers in tasks: progress, speed, ETA, build steps [1204/3876].

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside buttons and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a section label and its grid; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin of a screen title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, progress tracks, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, task rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and their thumbnails, dialogs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the count bubble on the Tasks nav item.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. Cards never cast shadows: they are set apart by fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the sidebar.

tokens.name: card-engine-width
tokens.usage: Engine card width; engine cards scroll horizontally in one row.

tokens.name: card-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum project and asset card width; the grid fills the row with as many as fit.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and nav items.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, nav and badges (Lucide, stroke 2).
